description: This file defines the class SugarCacheMemcached, which implements caching functionality using Memcached for the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM platform. It includes methods for initializing the memcached connection, setting, retrieving, deleting, and flushing cache entries. The class extends SugarCacheAbstract and interacts with external Memcached servers based on configuration.

classes.name: SugarCacheMemcached
classes.description: Class implementing caching mechanism using Memcached, extending SugarCacheAbstract.

methods.name: useBackend
methods.description: Determines if the Memcached backend should be used based on extension availability and configuration.

methods.name: _getMemcachedObject
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Memcached object instance, configuring host and port from settings.

methods.name: _setExternal
methods.description: Sets a cache entry in Memcached with a key and value.

methods.name: _getExternal
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry from Memcached by key.

methods.name: _clearExternal
methods.description: Deletes a cache entry from Memcached by key.

methods.name: _resetExternal
methods.description: Flushes all entries from the Memcached server.
